Commentary.Commentary: Proteas Women rejoice - That's it from this series and there's just one thing left to do - Laura Wolvaardt collects the series-winning Trophy and joins her teammates as they celebrate a fine series victory over a strong opponent. It is now time to say goodbye, but first let's have a look at what these two teams will be up to next. South Africa Women will have a bit of a break now and start their preparation for the T20 World Cup, due to begin in June. On the other hand, India Women will also have a break before heading to England a bit early, as they will be playing a white-ball series against the World Cup hosts England just before the mega event. That is all from us, hope you enjoyed the coverage. Until next time then, take care and goodbye.

Laura Wolvaardt - Player of the Series! The skipper of South Africa Women, Laura Wolvaardt, gets the accolade for the Player of the Match for her stellar knock of 92 unbeaten runs off just 56 balls. She is also named the Player of the Series for accumulating 330 runs over the course of the 5 matches. Wolvaardt says that she is very happy. Coming off a tough series against New Zealand and turning it around here was pretty good. Adds that winning all the tosses certainly helped, and a couple of things went her way, which was great. Mentions that the wicket here tends to be flat but being the end of the season, they thought it would stay low and slow, so picked the team according to that. Shares that there is always room for improvement, they want to be better in the fielding department going into the World Cup. Ends by saying that it was a brilliant series, the crowd was superb and they loved playing in front of them.

The captain of India Women - Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women says it was disappointing to lose, but she is optimistic for giving all the players a chance in the series. Adds that they didn't score many in the Powerplay and lost two wickets, which didn't help in the chase. Feels there are a lot of learnings from this series. They have a keen understanding of how South Africa Women play, they know their plans and that will help during the mega event. Ends by appreciating the support from the fans and hopes they keep supporting.
The Presentation ceremony...

Let's recap the first innings - Earlier in the day, Laura Wolvaardt won a fifth straight toss in this series and opted to bat first for the first time. Wolvaardt led from the front but the other batters struggled to find their timing. However, Sune Luus did manage to stick around for a long while as the opening duo added 75 runs. The Indian spinners showed their class in the middle overs as Sree Charani and Deepti Sharma picked up a couple of wickets each, so did pacer Renuka Singh Thakur, but they leaked runs right at the death, allowing the hosts to get to a total in excess of 150 runs.

India's concerns with the bat keep mounting - India Women have certainly been out-batted throughout this series and barring a couple of knocks here and there, the batting order simply hasn't clicked as a unit. Shafali Verma fell early and Jemimah Rodrigues soon followed suit as the visitors kept losing wickets at regular intervals. The highest stand was between skipper Harmanpreet Kaur and Bharti Fulmali, worth 38 runs, and the latter did score a handy 40, but it wasn't enough. Richa Ghosh came way too late to make a real impact but she did stay unbeaten on 25 off just 15 balls, and maybe she could have been pushed up the order a bit.

Another box ticked for South Africa Women - Laura Wolvaardt won yet another toss in this series, and for the first time, she elected to defend a score rather than chase it, and her bowlers have certainly stepped up. The score on the board was a good one given the nature of the surface but one good partnership, or one big knock, and it could have been gunned down. It was an all-round bowling effort and barring Annerie Dercksen, everyone contributed with at least one wicket and were fairly economical. Eliz-Mari Marx got the crucial early breakthrough and it was Nonkululeko Mlaba who was the pick of the bowlers, picking up a couple of wickets for just 15 runs in her four overs.

Proteas win big in Benoni - South Africa Women had already sealed the series in the third game, but they have ended up being 4-1 winners of this five-match T20I series. This win against the reigning ODI World Champions will give them a lot of confidence heading into the T20 World Cup. On the other hand, India Women will take this series as a pinch of salt and will look to get back to their best as they continue their preparation for the upcoming mega event.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and around leg, Harmanpreet Kaur helps it past short fine. Nonkululeko Mlaba gives a good chase and keeps it down to two runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.1: Nadine De Klerk to Harmanpreet Kaur, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Nadine De Klerk to have a bowl now.
Short and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur moves back and nudges it through mid-wicket for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.6: Nonkululeko Mlaba to Harmanpreet Kaur, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Up and over! Gives this one some more air, full and around off. Harmanpreet Kaur gets her hands through the shot, hits it through the line and over mid off for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.5: Nonkululeko Mlaba to Harmanpreet Kaur, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter, full and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur drills it down the pitch, where Nonkululeko Mlaba dives to her right on the follow-through to make a half-stop.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.4: Nonkululeko Mlaba to Harmanpreet Kaur, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Excellent fielding! Flighted, full and on off, Anushka Sharma pushes it wide of extra cover and sets off for the run. Laura Wolvaardt dives to her right and makes a fine stop. She gets up and throws it at the batter's end, where Kaur has to hurry but makes her ground.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.3: Nonkululeko Mlaba to Anushka Sharma, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, full and on middle, Anushka Sharma blocks it out.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.2: Nonkululeko Mlaba to Anushka Sharma, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Floated, short and around off, turns away, Harmanpreet Kaur backs away and punches it through covers for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.1: Nonkululeko Mlaba to Harmanpreet Kaur, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Nonkululeko Mlaba comes on to bowl right after the Powerplay.
Keeps the length short again, on middle, Anushka Sharma miscues her pull off the toe-end towards mid on. India Women are 28/2 at the end of the Powerplay!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.6: Ayabonga Khaka to Anushka Sharma, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Bangs this into the pitch, just outside off, Anushka Sharma slaps it but cannot beat extra cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.5: Ayabonga Khaka to Anushka Sharma, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Hard length and on off, Anushka Sharma stabs it towards extra cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.4: Ayabonga Khaka to Anushka Sharma, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: The physio is out to perform a mandatory concussion check on Harmanpreet Kaur. Replays show that it was a solid blow on the right side of the helmet but thankfully, Kaur looks fine.

Tries to be cheeky but doesn't come off! Touch fuller and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur gets down and across for the scoop but the ball goes off the face of the bat to the side of the helmet. It rolls towards point, where the fielder picks up and throws unnecessarily, allowing a run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.3: Ayabonga Khaka to Harmanpreet Kaur, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur rides the bounce and dabs it to point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.2: Ayabonga Khaka to Harmanpreet Kaur, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and around off, Anushka Sharma punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.1: Ayabonga Khaka to Anushka Sharma, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Ayabonga Khaka to continue and bowl the final over of the Powerplay.

Four dots on the trot to end the over! Fuller again and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur tucks it to short mid-wicket. Despite the boundary, just 5 runs off the over. Marx figures read 3-0-12-1. Superb stuff from her.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.6: Eliz-Mari Marx to Harmanpreet Kaur, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Slower one, full and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur clips it to mid-wicket.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.5: Eliz-Mari Marx to Harmanpreet Kaur, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Hits the length hard and around off, Harmanpreet Kaur steers it away towards point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.4: Eliz-Mari Marx to Harmanpreet Kaur, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Bangs this into the pitch, but angling down the leg side. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to pull it away, but gloves it behind. It falls short of the diving keeper to her left.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.3: Eliz-Mari Marx to Harmanpreet Kaur, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and on off, Anushka Sharma punches it towards extra cover. Laura Wolvaardt gets low to stop it but the ball deflects off her knee, allowing the batters to take the single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.2: Eliz-Mari Marx to Anushka Sharma, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Fine shot! Short of a length and well outside off. Anushka Sharma gets the chance to free her arms. Her bottom hand comes off the bat after contact but she crunches it through point for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Eliz-Mari Marx to Anushka Sharma, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Eliz-Mari Marx to bowl a third over on the trot.
Superb comeback from Ayabonga Khaka. Keeps it short and bowls it on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur nudges it to mid-wicket.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.6: Ayabonga Khaka to Harmanpreet Kaur, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: A bit short and around off. Harmanpreet Kaur knocks it to cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Ayabonga Khaka to Harmanpreet Kaur, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a good length, outside off. Kaur punches it to point. The fielder dives to her right and makes an excellent stop.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Ayabonga Khaka to Harmanpreet Kaur, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: India Women are two down inside the first 4 overs, and that brings the skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur, to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN. Another one falls. Khaka bowls into the surface on the shorter side, around off. Gets to a nice height for Jemimah to pull it away, and she goes after it, but plays off the higher part of the blade. She fails to get the connection and Chloe Tryon at deep square leg makes no mistake. India in some early troube.
Commentary.Howout: c Chloe Tryon b Ayabonga Khaka
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Ayabonga Khaka to Jemimah Rodrigues, OUT! c Chloe Tryon b Ayabonga Khaka.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length delivery, around off. Jemimah Rodrigues respectfully keeps it out.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Ayabonga Khaka to Jemimah Rodrigues, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Hard length delivery on the slower side, around off. Sharma gets on her toes and tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Ayabonga Khaka to Anushka Sharma, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FIVE WIDES! Terrible start by Ayabonga Khaka. Bashes it short and down leg. Sharma steps across to flick it away but misses and it rolls past the keeper and into the fence.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Ayabonga Khaka to Anushka Sharma, 5 Wides!

Commentary.Commentary: Quick single to end the over. Too full and on middle. Sharma drills it to mid on for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Eliz-Mari Marx to Anushka Sharma, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Touch fuller, around the fourth stump line. Sharma presses and punches but straight to short cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Eliz-Mari Marx to Anushka Sharma, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Wide! Pushes it full and down leg. Anushka Sharma looks to flick but misses.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Eliz-Mari Marx to Anushka Sharma, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Into the surface, slightly short and on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues fends it away on the leg side for a quick single to get underway.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Eliz-Mari Marx to Jemimah Rodrigues, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a nagging length, around off, slight away movement. Jemimah Rodrigues puts in a strong defensive prod.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Eliz-Mari Marx to Jemimah Rodrigues, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: An early breakthrough for the hosts, and out walks Jemimah Rodrigues to bat at number 3 for India.

OUT! GONE! Big wicket for South Africa Women, as Verma departs. Not a great delivery from Marx. Errs in line and drifts one on the pads. Verma tries to use the pace as she sweeps along the way, but ends up hitting it straight in the hands of short fine leg. Good catch by Chloe Tryon, getting low to her left.
Commentary.Howout: c Chloe Tryon b Eliz-Mari Marx

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, full and on middle. AS turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Chloe Tryon to Anushka Sharma, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Creamed in the gap! Pitches it up, around off. Anushka Sharma leans and nicely drives it through covers, in the gap for a boundary. Much better shot from Sharma.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Chloe Tryon to Anushka Sharma, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: In the air...lands safely. Chloe Tryon slows up the pace and bowls it flat on middle. Anushka Sharma comes down the track to heave but gets beaten for the pace. Ends up hitting it over mid on for a couple of runs. Sharma is underway.

Commentary.Commentary: A good start with the ball from the Proteas Women. It will be Chloe Tryon to operate from the other end.
Three dots to end the over. Fractionally full, outside off. Anushka Sharma half-presses and pushes it to point. Tidy start by Eliz-Mari Marx.
